subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The reviewer shall record token spend per pass/internal round and sum it per process and fleet by effective depth and pass count; budget targets are descriptive operating measurements and shall never change FR-24's floor or a completed pass's verdict.
fit_criterion: spend is reconstructable from canonical routed outcomes and EVT-7; a measured target overrun changes only the cost signal, while a mechanical cap that prevents a pass terminal is handled as an absent required pass under UB-9
